grand_bank_ads.title: The Grand Bank and Grand Trust
grand_bank_ads.//: Story Phase 15: the Grand Bank's own commercial, which the Stenchmaster Channel shows although the bank concluded business (Phase 14). It is now advertising a branch. Nobody knows which.

beats.line: announcer: THE GRAND STENCHMASTER'S GRAND BANK AND GRAND TRUST.
announcer: Now with a branch NEAR YOU. Very near you. In your room, possibly.
announcer: YOUR GAS IS OUR BUSINESS!
